data.name: Kuldip Bisen
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Kuldip Bisen has made a big mark in cricket. With 16 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 50*, with an average of 19.91 and a quick strike rate of 133.54. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 16 sixes and 9 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 7.0 overs, taking 1 wickets at an economy rate of 11.29. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
